title: THE CHAI RAVE @ Descent Boston

Boston breathes Bombay. The Chai Rave culture is officially taking over. ‍

About this Event 
 https://cdn-az.allevents.in/events9/banners/d26aa950-c72c-11f1-b689-9594e1faa8b2-rimg-w740-h740-dc480808-gmir.jpg 

If you’ve been looking for a nightlife experience that actually hits different, this is it. We are rewriting the script on South Asian nightlife. This isn't just a party—it’s a whole movement. We’re bringing pure main-character energy to Boston for an exclusive, highly immersive pop-up night.
Come for the community, stay for the absolute sonic journey. Different People. Same Energy. ⚡

🎵 The Soundtrack (No Skips)
Our lineup is serving a heavy, non-stop curation of the tracks redefining the global club scene right now:
🔊 Bolly Tech (High-energy Bollywood vocals warped over dark, driving techno basslines)🎧 Indo House (Hypnotic, deep underground house fused with traditional South Asian elements)🌎 Global Sounds (Transnational club beats to keep you moving till 2 AM)

🎧 The Lineup
Curating the ultimate late-night soundscape:
DJ DHARAKDJ PRANAVDJ SPXRSH

⚠️ Entry Info & Aesthetics
Age Limit: 21+ only. Bring valid physical IDs. No exceptions.Fits: Fashion Forward. Dress to express, not impress. Bring your best street style, archive pieces, or high-fashion looks. The venue is highly photogenic—don't ruin the grid. 📸Culture: Culture lives here. Respect the space, match the energy, and lose yourself in the music.
